description: Render a standard chess board set up with the initial starting position using the default green/cream color scheme.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_chess import Board

DEFAULT_FEN = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"

class ChessBoardInitial(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        board = Board()
        board.set_board_from_FEN(DEFAULT_FEN)
        self.add(board)
        self.wait(0.5)
